text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Russian newspapers this morning newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Chechnya is not going to give up its independence claims, the breakaway republic's authorities say on the eve of a meeting between Russian President Boris Yeltsin and Chechen leader Aslan Maskhadov.
- Belarussian authorities use arrests of Russian journalists as a means to exert political pressure on Moscow, the paper says.
- Top Russian officials recieve excessive fees for writing books, the paper says.
- According to a Russian Audit Chamber report, the Defence Ministry spends billions of roubles on official receptions while officers have not been paid for months.
